title: Counting Unsold Food
transcript:
Have you decided where we should start our supermarket waste survey? The manager says we can observe one department during our first visit.
I'd choose the bakery. Its staff clear the shelves together, so we can see everything that leaves the display.
Good. Shall we ask for the retail price of each unsold item as well?
For the first visit, I'd record weight. That gives us a common measure even when the items vary in size.
We also need to know where the food goes. Some of it might still be eaten.
I'll add a separate column for donations. Staff can fill it in before the trays leave the department.
When I visited, the manager said most leftovers were entered on the system after closing.
Then let's schedule both visits on weekdays. The manager says weekend shifts follow a different routine, and we want comparable records.

questions.prompt: The students will start their survey in the ____.
questions.explanation: 学生选择了面包部门，因为那里的员工会集中清理货架。

questions.prompt: The students will use ____ as a common measure for items of different sizes.
questions.explanation: 学生提出记录重量，以便比较大小不同的商品。

questions.prompt: The recording sheet will have a separate column for ____.
questions.explanation: 学生说会在表上增设一栏，用来记录捐赠的食品。

questions.prompt: When are most leftovers entered into the supermarket's system?
questions.explanation: 经理说大部分剩余食品在关门后才录入系统。

questions.prompt: How will the students make the two visits more comparable?
options: They will visit during the same staff member's shifts.
They will visit once on a weekday and once at the weekend.
They will make both visits on weekdays.
questions.answer: They will make both visits on weekdays.
questions.explanation: 学生决定两次都在工作日去，因为周末班次的流程不同。
